cells.condition: The lord of the ascendant, or Jupiter, or Mercury occupies or aspects the ascendant
cells.effect: The ascendant becomes powerful (and not so by other planets)

cells.condition: A house is powerful and its lord is powerful
cells.effect: The objects signified by the house are promoted; if either is weak, they are reduced

cells.condition: A benefic occupies a bhava / a malefic occupies a bhava
cells.effect: Benefics promote the bhava and malefics reduce it — reversed in the 6th, 8th, 12th

cells.condition: Dignity of the occupying planet: exalted / moolatrikona / own / friendly / inimical / debilitated-or-combust
cells.effect: Effects full / three-quarters / one-half / one-quarter / less than one-quarter / wholly fail

cells.condition: The planet occupying the 10th from Lagna or Moon (Sun-father, Moon-mother, Mars-enemy, Mercury-friend, Jupiter-brother, Venus-wife, Saturn-servant); and the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 10th
cells.effect: Source of wealth and the avocation follow that planet

cells.condition: The yoga planet occupies a friendly / inimical / own / exaltation sign
cells.effect: Wealth through a friend / an enemy / that house / the native's own powers

cells.condition: Jupiter, the lord of the Moon's sign, or the lord of the ascendant occupies a Kendra
cells.effect: The native is happy in his manhood

cells.condition: Vargottama lagna-navamsa or Moon; benefics in the 2nd from the Sun; Kendras empty of planets
cells.effect: The native is happy and prosperous

cells.condition: Planets in own/exalted/moolatrikona signs in Kendras are Karaka to one another; a planet in the 10th from another is its special Karaka
Charts in which 'the signs Aries, Cancer and Leo are occupied by their lords' (and cognate patterns)
cells.effect: Birth of kings (if born in a king's family) / richness otherwise

cells.condition: Dasa of a Raja-yoga planet in the 10th or Lagna, or of the most powerful planet; vs dasa of planets in inimical or depression signs
cells.effect: Kingdom obtained in the former, lost in the latter

cells.condition: The dasa lord in a Prishtodaya / Sirodaya sign; Sun and Mars act on sign entry, Jupiter and Venus mid-sign, Saturn and Moon before leaving, Mercury throughout
cells.effect: Effects manifest late in the period / at its start; planets time their effects within a sign

notes: Brihat Jataka states lord-arrangement doctrine as PRINCIPLES (house+lord power, dignity grading, benefic/malefic) plus specific Raja-yoga charts — not a systematic 12x12 'lord of N in house M' table. That table belongs to later texts and is NOT filled here (charter: no chapter, no doctrine). Each rule is a draft awaiting Scholar Reviewer verification.
